posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: HOLLOWGRAPH supports only two commands, "get" and "send", yet maintains persistence of its cloud communications through DNS tunneling. Using specially crafted IPv6 AAAA queries to cloudlanecdn[.]com, the malware refreshes Microsoft Entra ID credentials required to authenticate to its Microsoft Graph-based C2 channel. #MalwareAnalysis
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：HOLLOWGRAPH 僅支援兩個命令“獲取”和“發送”，但透過 DNS 隧道保持其雲端通訊的持久性。此惡意軟體使用特製的 IPv6 AAAA 查詢 cloudlanecdn[.]com，刷新對基於 Microsoft Graph 的 C2 通道進行身份驗證所需的 Microsoft Entra ID 憑證。 #惡意軟體分析

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Instead of using traditional C2 infrastructure, #HOLLOWGRAPH stores operator tasking and stolen data inside calendar events scheduled for 13 May 2050. The implant retrieves commands from encrypted attachments and uploads exfiltrated files back to the same mailbox as File{n}.txt attachments, using separate RSA key pairs and AES-256-GCM encryption for each communication direction. Defenders should hunt for calendar events with Event ID: <taskid> {} subjects or the Boss{}ID{} naming convention. #ThreatIntel #APT
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#HOLLOWGRAPH 不使用傳統的 C2 基礎設施，而是將操作員任務和被盜資料儲存在計畫於 2050 年 5 月 13 日的日曆事件中。植入程式從加密附件中檢索命令，並將洩漏的檔案上傳回與 File{n}.txt 附件相同的郵箱，每個通訊方向使用單獨的 RSA 金鑰對和 AES-256-GCM 加密。防禦者應尋找具有事件 ID 的日曆事件：<taskid> {} 主題或 Boss{}ID{} 命名約定。 #威脅英特爾#APT

posts.text: ⚠️ When two "medium-looking" vulnerabilities meet, the outcome isn't always medium. The recently disclosed wp2shell chain is a good example of why vulnerabilities should be evaluated as attack paths rather than isolated CVEs. A REST API authorization bypass (CVE-2026-63030) removes the authentication barrier. A separate SQL injection (CVE-2026-60137) suddenly becomes reachable. Neither issue tells the full story on its own, but together they can lead to administrative compromise and, ultimately, remote code execution. What makes this case stand out is that the vulnerabilities affect WordPress Core, not a third-party plugin or theme. In our latest blog, we explain: • How the exploit chain works • Which WordPress versions are affected • Why the combined risk is much higher than the individual CVSS scores suggest • What defenders should verify after applying the patches If you're responsible for WordPress environments, this is worth reviewing. ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-critical-rce-chain #WordPress #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE
posts.text_zh: ⚠️ 當兩個「中等」的漏洞相遇時，結果並不總是中等。最近揭露的 wp2shell 鍊是一個很好的例子，說明了為什麼漏洞應該被評估為攻擊路徑而不是孤立的 CVE。 REST API 授權繞過 (CVE-2026-63030) 消除了身分驗證障礙。突然可以存取單獨的 SQL 注入 (CVE-2026-60137)。這兩個問題本身都無法說明全部問題，但它們結合起來可能會導致管理妥協，並最終導致遠端程式碼執行。這個案例之所以引人注目，是因為這些漏洞影響的是 WordPress 核心，而不是第三方外掛或主題。在我們最新的部落格中，我們解釋了： • 漏洞利用鍊如何運作 • 哪些 WordPress 版本受到影響 • 為什麼綜合風險遠高於單一 CVSS 分數建議的風險 • 應用修補程式後防禦者應驗證哪些內容 如果您負責 WordPress 環境，則值得查看。 ➡️ http://threatmon.io/inside-wp2shell-how-two-wordpress-core-bugs-became-a-ritic-rce-chain #WordPress #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence #ApplicationSecurity #RCE #CVE

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 4M São Paulo Student Records A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor known as 'Confia Company' is allegedly selling a database containing personal information of over 4 million students from the São Paulo State Department of Education (SEDUC-SP). The listing, posted on July 16, 2026, claims the data was extracted directly from the API of 'Sala do Futuro,' the official educational platform used by the state's public school system. According to the post, the dataset covers approximately 1,480 cities within São Paulo state and includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) for each student. The alleged exposed fields include: * Student ID and RA (Registration Number) * Full name * CPF (Brazilian national ID) and RG (state ID) * Date of birth and gender * Email addresses * Parents' full names * Complete home addresses (street, number, neighborhood, ZIP code, city, state) * Geolocation coordinates (latitude/longitude) * Class enrollment details The listing provides sample records showing data for students in cities such as São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Araraquara, and São Caetano do Sul, confirming the presence of CPFs, parent names, and precise address details. The actor invites interested buyers to contact them via Telegram or Session for pricing. São Paulo State is the largest education system in Brazil, serving millions of students annually. The exposure of such granular data, including geolocation and national identification numbers, poses significant risks of identity theft, social engineering, and physical safety threats to minors and their families. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by SEDUC-SP or security researchers. #DataBreach #EducationSecurity #Brazil #SaoPaulo #PII #DarkWeb #StudentData

posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：自 2026 年 5 月以來，Group-IB 威脅情報已在 33 個國家/地區識別出 100 多個 ClickLock Stealer 受害者，證明 macOS 威脅正在演變為超越罕見、複雜的攻擊。該惡意軟體使用受損的 WordPress 基礎設施進行有效負載傳輸，並在執行後自行刪除，留下最少的取證痕跡。請在此處閱讀 Group-IB 的完整技術細分：https://link.group-ib.com/4gC4lHJ

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The #malware targets 8 browsers, 31 #cryptowallet extensions, 7 password managers, and 8 desktop wallet applications. Using a modular architecture, ClickLock Stealer employs a GSocket backdoor installer disguised as iCloud, a credential stealer, Keychain stealer, and crypto-focused harvester that extracts #blockchain addresses across 6 chains. All components exfiltrate data via #Telegram Bot API, while the backdoor provides persistent remote access.
posts.text_zh: R 至 @GroupIB_TI：#malware 的目標是 8 個瀏覽器、31 個 #cryptowallet 擴充功能、7 個密碼管理器和 8 個桌面錢包應用程式。 ClickLock Stealer 採用模組化架構，採用偽裝成 iCloud 的 GSocket 後門安裝程式、憑證竊取程式、鑰匙圈竊取程式和以加密貨幣為中心的收割機，可跨 6 個鏈提取 #blockchain 位址。所有元件都透過#Telegram Bot API 竊取數據，而後門則提供持久的遠端存取。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: #ClickLockStealer implements a layered approach to credential theft. If a victim enters their password willingly, the attack completes in seconds. If they refuse, the #malware installs LaunchAgents for persistence and activates a kill-loop terminating Finder, Dock, SystemUIServer, and Terminal every 210 milliseconds, leaving only a fake password dialog on screen until #compliance is achieved. The same coercion technique forces approval of a macOS Keychain authorization prompt to extract Chrome's Safe Storage AES key.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：#ClickLockStealer 實作了一種分層的憑證竊取方法。如果受害者自願輸入密碼，攻擊將在幾秒鐘內完成。如果他們拒絕，#malware 會安裝 LaunchAgents 以實現持久性，並每 210 毫秒啟動一個終止循環，終止 Finder、Dock、SystemUIServer 和終端，只在螢幕上留下一個假密碼對話框，直到實作 #compliance。同樣的強制技術會強制批准 macOS 鑰匙圈授權提示，以擷取 Chrome 的安全儲存 AES 金鑰。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: A new #macOS stealer named #ClickLockStealer has been discovered with zero detections on VirusTotal, targeting users across Europe, North America, and MEA. The malware uses #ClickFix social engineering to trick victims into pasting a malicious command into Terminal, then forces password entry killing all visible applications until the user complies, acting as a "locker". The attack chain requires no exploits or elevated privileges to succeed. #ThreatIntel
posts.text_zh: 在 VirusTotal 上發現了一種名為 #ClickLockStealer 的新 #macOS 竊取程序，其目標是歐洲、北美和中東和非洲地區的用戶，檢測結果為零。該惡意軟體使用 #ClickFix 社交工程來誘騙受害者將惡意命令粘貼到終端中，然後強制輸入密碼以殺死所有可見應用程序，直到用戶遵守為止，充當“儲物櫃”。攻擊鏈無需利用任何漏洞或提升權限即可成功。 #威脅英特爾

posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: RedHook integrates code from the #Shizuku framework to execute protected system APIs once ADB Wireless Debugging is enabled. posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Security teams are facing a complex adversary landscape where arrests of a few individuals do not stop the overall threat. The decentralized nature of Scattered Spider and its subclusters makes it a constantly evolving menace, focused on social engineering to bypass traditional MFA. Gain a comprehensive understanding of their tactics, objectives, and how the collective operates. Read the full blog here: https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：安全團隊面臨複雜的對手形勢，逮捕少數人並不能阻止整體威脅。 Scattered Spider 及其子群集的去中心化性質使其成為一種不斷發展的威脅，專注於社會工程以繞過傳統的 MFA。全面了解他們的策略、目標以及集體的運作方式。在此閱讀完整部落格：https://link.group-ib.com/4ba31rU

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: The primary vector for ScatteredSpider’s initial access is highly targeted social engineering, but it relies on a specific toolset to exploit human trust. Subclusters deploy sophisticated #phishing kits that mimic Okta, Microsoft, and Citrix login pages, sometimes only kept online for a few minutes during a phone call. Our deep dive reveals how these attacks are orchestrated, combining vishing and smishing techniques to direct victims to credential-harvesting sites before delivering a #RAT or other payload.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：ScatteredSpider 初始訪問的主要向量是高度針對性的社會工程，但它依賴於特定的工具集來利用人類信任。子叢集部署複雜的 #phishing 工具包，模仿 Okta、Microsoft 和 Citrix 登入頁面，有時僅在通話期間保持線上幾分鐘。我們深入研究了這些攻擊是如何精心策劃的，結合了語音釣魚和網路釣魚技術，在傳遞 #RAT 或其他有效負載之前將受害者引導至憑證收集網站。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Our analysis shows that Scattered Spider subclusters consistently target employees of major identity providers and marketing platforms like Twilio and Mailchimp as a stepping stone. The end goal is rarely the initial victim; it's to leverage internal tools for phishing campaigns against #cryptocurrency users. Simultaneous operations targeting #Okta login pages and crypto wallets prove the primary objective across these independent subclusters remains financial gain through crypto theft.
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：我們的分析表明，分散的蜘蛛子集群始終以主要身份提供商和營銷平台（如 Twilio 和 Mailchimp）的員工作為墊腳石。最終目標很少是最初的受害者；它是利用內部工具針對#cryptocurrency 用戶進行網路釣魚活動。針對 #Okta 登入頁面和加密錢包的同時操作證明，這些獨立子集群的主要目標仍然是透過加密盜竊獲得經濟利益。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: Beyond digital #socialengineering, one ScatteredSpider subcluster has been observed resorting to physical theft, specifically stealing employee iPads from mobile carrier retail stores. To bypass device locks, attackers would impersonate internal departments to socially engineer the passcode from store staff. This hybrid physical-digital tactic highlights the lengths these subclusters will go to for SIM swapping operations, targeting telco employees and authorized retailers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile. #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：除了數字#socialengineering 之外，還觀察到一個 ScatteredSpider 子集群採取物理盜竊手段，特別是從移動運營商零售店竊取員工的 iPad。為了繞過設備鎖，攻擊者會冒充內部部門，對商店員工的密碼進行社會設計。這種實體-數位混合策略凸顯了這些子叢集將在 SIM 交換作業上花費大量時間，目標是電信員工和 Verizon、AT&T 和 T-Mobile 等授權零售商。 #威脅情報

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: Recent research reveals that #ScatteredSpider is not a singular organized group but a decentralized #cybercrime collective comprised of multiple, independent subclusters. This loose affiliation of operators, connected primarily through shared TTPs and social engineering techniques, poses a unique challenge for attribution. Our latest analysis explains how this structure, akin to a hacking movement, provides inherent resilience against #lawenforcement actions. It's not a single group to track, but a persistent culture of cybercrime that evolves continuously.
posts.text_zh: 最近的研究表明，#ScatteredSpider 並不是一個單一的有組織團體，而是由多個獨立子集群組成的去中心化的#cybercrime 集體。營運商的這種鬆散聯繫（主要透過共享 TTP 和社會工程技術進行連接）對歸因提出了獨特的挑戰。我們的最新分析解釋了這種類似於駭客運動的結構如何提供針對#lawenforcement 行動的固有彈性。它不是一個需要追蹤的單一群體，而是一種持續發展的持續網路犯罪文化。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #MilleniumRAT (v4.x) marks a significant evolution in the threat landscape. The #malware has been completely rewritten from .NET to a native C++ application, removing .NET dependencies. This architectural shift enables greater stealth and resilience, making detection more challenging. The #Telegram Bot API remains the core C2 mechanism.
posts.text_zh: 固定：#MilleniumRAT (v4.x) 標誌著威脅格局的重大演變。 #malware 已從 .NET 完全重寫為本機 C++ 應用程序，刪除了 .NET 依賴項。這種架構轉變可實現更大的隱密性和彈性，使檢測更具挑戰性。 #Telegram Bot API 仍然是核心 C2 機制。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: SilabRAT places significant emphasis on #cryptocurrency theft. Beyond harvesting credentials and browser data, it can identify wallet-related artifacts and automatically attempt password recovery using credentials collected from infected systems. These additions reflect the growing focus on direct monetization within modern #malware ecosystems.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 非常重視#cryptocurrency 竊盜。除了收集憑證和瀏覽器資料之外，它還可以識別與錢包相關的工件，並使用從受感染系統收集的憑證自動嘗試恢復密碼。這些新增內容反映了現代#惡意軟體生態系統中對直接貨幣化的日益關注。

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: R to @GroupIB_TI: One of SilabRAT's most notable capabilities is its use of Hidden Virtual Network Computing (HVNC). By interacting with services directly from the victim's device, attackers can perform account activity, access sensitive platforms, and conduct fraudulent operations while appearing as a legitimate user originating from the trusted device and IP address. #InfoSec
posts.text_zh: R 致@GroupIB_TI：SilabRAT 最顯著的功能之一是它使用隱藏虛擬網路運算 (HVNC)。透過直接從受害者的裝置與服務交互，攻擊者可以執行帳戶活動、存取敏感平台並進行詐騙操作，同時表現為來自受信任裝置和 IP 位址的合法使用者。 #資訊安全

posts.name: GroupIB_TI
posts.text: #SilabRAT is a newly emerging Malware-as-a-Service (#MaaS) platform developed by the threat actor "o1oo1" and advertised on underground forums since late 2025. Sold for $5,000 per month, the Remote Access Trojan (#RAT) combines credential theft, session hijacking, HVNC access, Chrome App-Bound Encryption bypasses using COM elevation, and cryptocurrency-focused tooling into a single platform built for financially motivated cybercrime.
posts.text_zh: #SilabRAT 是一個新興的惡意軟體即服務 (#MaaS) 平台，由威脅行為者「o1oo1」開發，自 2025 年底以來在地下論壇上做廣告。遠端存取木馬 (#RAT) 每月售價 5,000 美元，將憑證盜竊、會話劫持、HVNC 存取、使用 COM 提升的 Chrome 應用程式綁定加密繞過以及以加密貨幣為中心的工具整合到一個為出於經濟動機的網路犯罪。

posts.text: This made my day: Brazilian Authorities Will Revive Fraud Case Against George Santos. A 2008 court case had been suspended because Brazilian law enforcement officials could not find Mr. Santos. https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/02/nyregion/george-santos-brazil.html
posts.text_zh: 這讓我很高興：巴西當局將恢復針對喬治桑托斯的詐欺案。由於巴西執法官員找不到桑托斯先生，2008 年的一個法庭案件已被暫停。 https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/02/nyregion/george-santos-brazil.html

posts.text: R to @briankrebs: Turned off protected mode for a bit. Let the firehose commence.
posts.text_zh: R 致@briankrebs：暫時關閉保護模式。讓消防水帶開始。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Hey @elonmusk, since you don't seem to have much a media/comms team anymore, can you address the apparently legitimate claim that someone scraped & is now selling data on hundreds of millions of Twitter accounts? Maybe it didn't happen on your watch, but you owe Twitter a reply.
posts.text_zh: 嘿@elonmusk，既然你似乎不再有太多的媒體/通訊團隊，你能解決一下有人在數億個 Twitter 帳戶上抓取並出售數據的明顯合法的說法嗎？也許這不是在你手錶上發生的，但你欠 Twitter 一個回應。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: Just enjoyed several glorious days when I didn't even think about Twitter. Wandered back just now to see what's new, and yep about what I expected.
posts.text_zh: 只是享受了幾天美好的時光，我什至沒有想到推特。剛才又回來看看有什麼新鮮事，是的，關於我所期望的。

posts.name: briankrebs
posts.text: This article could easily be updated to reflect the current reason a lot of people here (particularly journalists) have their accounts locked: It slows the firehose of bot replies from gajillions of accounts that don't follow you. It's probably also come to mean FU to Twitter.
posts.text_zh: 這篇文章可以輕鬆更新，以反映當前許多人（尤其是記者）的帳戶被鎖定的原因：它減慢了來自無數不關注您的帳戶的機器人回复的速度。對 Twitter 來說，它也可能意味著 FU。
